ServiceFeatures.title: What this service may include.
ServiceFeatures.description: These capabilities describe the typical direction of the service. Final scope depends on the project requirements, integrations, workflows and priorities confirmed during onboarding.
ServiceFeatures.resultsTitle: What the finished solution should move toward.
ServiceFeatures.resultsDescription: These are practical outcomes the service is designed to support, not guaranteed performance metrics.

ServiceTechnology.title: Selected tools, with a reason for being there.
ServiceTechnology.description: The stack is shaped around the approved scope, integrations, performance needs and long-term maintenance direction. These are typical choices for this service, not fixed requirements for every project.

ServiceDelivery.title: A clear path from discovery to delivery.
ServiceDelivery.description: Every engagement moves through a structured sequence. The public timeline provides planning direction, while the approved project later receives its own real dates, status and execution milestones.
ServiceDelivery.planningDisclaimer: This is a planning range, not a contractual deadline. The final project timeline is confirmed after scope review and becomes part of the approved quote and project plan.

ServicePricing.title: Start with a range. Finalize after scope.
ServicePricing.description: These figures provide an initial commercial direction for this service. The approved quote is prepared after the project requirements are reviewed.
ServicePricing.quoteFactorsDescription: Final pricing depends on project scope, integrations, technical complexity, delivery timeline, compliance requirements and ongoing support needs.
ServicePricing.customScopeDescription: Larger, unusual or regulated scopes can be reviewed as a custom offer.

ServiceOnboarding.title: A few things we will need from you.
ServiceOnboarding.description: These questions form part of the service onboarding flow. They help us understand the project direction, requirements and constraints before preparing the final scope or custom offer.

ServiceOnboarding.fullOnboardingDescription: Once you start the request, these questions become the structured intake that helps us prepare the service review and quote.

ServiceFaq.title: Questions before you request the service.
ServiceFaq.description: These answers provide general guidance. Exact technical, commercial and delivery decisions are confirmed after your project requirements have been reviewed.
ServiceFaq.helper: Still unsure whether this service fits your project? You can begin with a custom request and we will help determine the right direction.

ServiceDetailCTA.title: Ready to shape this service around your project?
ServiceDetailCTA.description: Tell us what you are trying to build. We will review the requirements, workflows, integrations and delivery direction before preparing the right scope and offer.

WebDevelopmentStory.title: Websites built to work for your business.
WebDevelopmentStory.description: From focused landing pages and professional business websites to complete custom web applications, Rcentz builds responsive digital experiences around your brand, customers and real business workflows.

WordPressStory.title: Keep what works. Modernize what does not.
WordPressStory.description: Rcentz develops, repairs and modernizes WordPress websites while preserving the content, structure and business value that still matters.

MobileAdaptiveStory.title: Designed for every screen your customers use.
MobileAdaptiveStory.description: Rcentz creates mobile and adaptive experiences intentionally around smaller screens, touch interaction and focused user journeys instead of simply compressing a desktop website.

BusinessSystemsStory.title: Put your operations in one system.
BusinessSystemsStory.description: Rcentz builds structured business systems that bring users, records, workflows, reporting and daily operations into one connected application.

EcommerceStory.title: Commerce built beyond the storefront.
EcommerceStory.description: Rcentz builds commerce experiences where products, customers, checkout, payments and operations work together as one connected system.

MaintenanceModernizationStory.description: Rcentz repairs, rebuilds and modernizes existing websites and applications while preserving the critical business content, data schema, and core functionality that drive your operations.
